policy: Preserve observed product and composition rules; never port HTML, CSS, DOM structure or web runtime into generated SwiftUI.

patterns.rule: Lead with one compact social context or urgent object, then authored content with identity, metadata and object-attached proof.

evidence.observation: A close-circle context appears before authored feed units.
Class context and an urgent read status precede the publication stream.

patterns.rule: Express status as product facts: who acted, how many completed, whose turn it is and what is due. Avoid generic activity labels.

evidence.observation: Read count and deadline are shown as one actionable fact.
Relationship context explains why a feed item matters.

patterns.rule: Treat profile as an identity destination opened from the root top bar; reserve the service tab for product features and utilities.

evidence.observation: Identity entry and service navigation have different jobs.
The social root keeps identity separate from feature navigation.

patterns.rule: A media-led root begins with one resumable hero containing subject, progress and one next action; a semantic gray placeholder is valid when imagery is unavailable.

evidence.observation: Continue, program identity and progress form one primary object.

patterns.rule: Keep the playing object, progress and next control together; queues and secondary collections follow the playback task.

evidence.observation: Current piece, time progress and next item remain one context.

patterns.rule: Attach title, source identity, live or duration metadata, actions, comments and timeline to the same media subject.

evidence.observation: Live state, match identity, channel, comments and moments describe one event.
Live, moments and upcoming events use distinct content rhythms.

patterns.rule: Reach every capability through a useful feature gesture, explain the value before the system prompt, show the granted result and preserve a denied fallback. Never create an access catalogue.

evidence.observation: Capabilities are distributed across creation, communication and discovery.
Permission moments belong to complete user scenarios.

patterns.rule: Differentiate through the world model, causal loop and one signature domain composition; vary accent, type or radius only after product structure is clear.

evidence.observation: The shared-plan object drives the screen more strongly than decoration.
House matter, audience and evidence form a product-specific object.

patterns.rule: Separate content, navigation and capability actions into named groups with native row heights and breathing room; do not render one dense utility dump.

evidence.observation: Related controls are grouped by user intent.
Secondary utilities follow the primary product context.
